## Strategy
Audited the supplied record. Only executions for the specified \((2,2,4,4)\) computation timed out with status \(124\); no successful task-owned artifact exists.

## Gaps
The certificate is **not established**. Missing are all degreewise matrices, Smith forms, ranks, quotient/torsion data, complementary minors, executable successful output, and the required checks
\[
r_d=\#\{\text{nonzero Smith entries}\},\qquad
\operatorname{coker}(M_d)\cong\mathbb Z^{n_d-r_d}\oplus\!\bigoplus_{s_{d,k}>1}\mathbb Z/s_{d,k},
\]
with every minor of size \(r_d\). The recorded failures are [artifact a0468ee387c57b44f37f131d0980e1487ec29d0998bbd1e2865c94761575bc6f; artifact 4cf117f029f16b069773ab564b589e10252c84158d61713f28167fb34b06dec7].

## Next
A successful witness-preserving computation artifact for the exact stated inputs is required; none is available in the supplied evidence.
